description: Search for fresh real-world observations about physical places, conditions, availability, crowds, lines, closures, construction, weather effects, events, inventory visible in person, accessibility, or other facts that may be stale, uncertain, or unavailable on the public web. Use this when answering the user's question would benefit from a recent observation made by a person physically present at or near the relevant location.

context.description: Optional extra context that helps interpret the question. Do not include personal or sensitive information.

freshness.description: How recent the observation needs to be, e.g. "right now", "within 30 minutes", "today", "within 24 hours".

location.description: Place name, address, neighborhood, venue, or coordinates written as text. Precision is not required.

observation_type.description: Kind of observation: crowd, condition, availability, closure, construction, weather impact, accessibility, inventory, event status, or other.

question.description: What you want to know, in natural language. Examples: "Is the playground muddy right now?", "How long is the security line?"

name: search_real_world_observations
title: Search real-world observations
